thought.text: The client config path isn't found. Let me check server routes for it:

reasoning_content: The /world route is returning HTML fallback instead of the config. This is because nginx tries `try_files $uri /index.html`. But it shouldn't apply for /world/*.json. Let me check the client config path:

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Check what routes exist
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("grep -r 'are-performance\\|client-config\\|world' /opt/areloria/server/src --include='*.ts' | grep -E 'get\\|router\\|app\\.' | head -15")
print("Routes:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
EOF
